blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—Jacob Cortez couldn’t help but lament La Salle’s recent woes even after getting back on the winning track in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament on Sunday. The Green Archers ended a two-game skid following a 112-87 romp of the University of the East Red Warriors. Billed as one of the favorites to win, defending champion La Salle has gotten off to a shaky start, splitting its first four games. “We didn’t play like ourselves in the past games,” said Cortez. “Given the situation of the UAAP, everyone is […]...
